name: moodboard-mcp
description: Use your Pinterest boards as design references: official OAuth login, images Claude can see, and extracted design tokens.
long_description: Log in to Pinterest with the official OAuth flow (read-only), let Claude see the images on your boards, and extract a color palette with roles, contrast ratios, CSS variables and Tailwind colors. Requires your own free Pinterest developer app: see the README.

tools.name: get_board_pins
tools.description: Get pins from a board, with images

tools.name: get_pin
tools.description: Get one pin with its image

tools.name: extract_design_tokens
tools.description: Palette, color roles, contrast, CSS and Tailwind from a board

prompts.name: moodboard_to_ui
prompts.description: Study a Pinterest board and build a UI in the same style
prompts.text: Use Pinterest board ${arguments.board_id} as the visual reference for: ${arguments.build}.

pinterest_client_id.title: Pinterest App ID
pinterest_client_id.description: From developers.pinterest.com/apps. Add http://localhost:8085/callback as a redirect URI in your app.

pinterest_client_secret.title: Pinterest App secret
pinterest_client_secret.description: Your Pinterest app's secret key. Stored by Claude Desktop, never sent anywhere except Pinterest.

pinterest_access_token.title: Access token (optional)
pinterest_access_token.description: Optional: a token generated in the Pinterest developer portal. Skips the OAuth login.
